bottlenecks.finding: Original router/HTTP path dominates before optimization
bottlenecks.evidence: Single router median CPU approximately one core; doubling batch nearly doubles generation/reward time while learner time remains nearly constant. ASR16 alone, W64, client inflight16 and concurrency32 variants remain about 36-37 seconds.
bottlenecks.intervention: Round-robin alone remains 37.02 s. Native eight-process routing plus its HTTP-pool implementation gives 17.83 s, 2.0768x versus single-process round-robin at the same 64 GPUs and ASR8.
bottlenecks.limitation: This intervention changes process count and native upstream HTTP-pool behavior; no isolated hot-function or process-count-only claim.

bottlenecks.finding: After router optimization, learner compute is no longer dominant
bottlenecks.interpretation: The matched 32-to-64 run saves 1.03 s in training, but generation/reward barely improves and publication adds 0.50 s. Actor training itself improves 1.90x; end-to-end throughput improves only 1.037x.

bottlenecks.finding: Fixed ASR admission and post-generation work consume the saved generation time
bottlenecks.interpretation: Increasing ASR replicas helps only after routing is unblocked. Remaining tail includes reward completion, artifacts/metrics, conversion/splitting, finish_rollout and RPC return. These overlapping quantities must not be added or labeled pure disk I/O, pure ASR GPU time, or pure GPU generation.

confirmation.failure_mechanism: Shared-admission sibling seqlock did not stabilize within fail-fast reads; admission shed requests and the native proxy mapped the false return to router_overloaded HTTP503.
log_sequence: sibling admission slot unstable; shedding until reclaim
sibling admission slots readable again; resuming admission
confirmation.code_path: source/omni/sglang_omni_router/python/admission_shm.py: SlotCodec.read(fail_fast=True), SharedAdmission.try_acquire and 50ms cached unstable shedding; python/proxy.py forward_model_request maps any failed admission to router_overloaded
confirmation.not_proven: A capacity-limit hit, ASR saturation as the failure cause, learner numerical divergence, or the exact OS/writer event that left the slot temporarily unreadable. The restored-readability warning does not by itself prove a DP crash or no crash.
confirmation.CPU_reproduction: analysis/reproduce-admission.json: same pinned module rejects with zero inflight while sibling seq is odd, keeps rejecting after writer resumes until cached 50ms reprobe expires, then admits without a process restart.
